data.body_html:
Choosing between the Astondoa 40, Azimut 39, and Fairline Targa 12m for your Marbella boat charter? All three are around 12 metres long, depart from Puerto Banús, and offer a premium day out on the Costa del Sol. But they differ in passenger capacity, style, and pricing. This comparison breaks down the key differences so you can pick the right boat for your group and budget. For a full overview of all options, visit our [Marbella boat rental hub](/).

At a Glance: Key Specs

Astondoa 40: The Comfort Cruiser

The Astondoa 40 is a Spanish-built motor yacht known for its spacious flybridge and stable ride. With a maximum of 9 passengers, it’s ideal for small groups or families who want a relaxed day cruising the Marbella coastline. The flybridge offers panoramic views, perfect for sunbathing or watching the sunset over La Concha. It’s a Tier A boat, so pricing is fixed at €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours, including all standard inclusions.

Azimut 39: Room for More

The Azimut 39 shares the same length and pricing tier as the Astondoa 40, but it can carry up to 11 passengers — two more. This makes it the best choice for slightly larger groups. The interior is sleek and Italian-designed, with a comfortable saloon and a spacious aft deck. Like the Astondoa, it departs from Puerto Banús and includes skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. For a side-by-side with another popular model, see our [Azimut 39 vs Pershing 46 comparison](/blog/azimut-39-vs-pershing-46-marbella-comparison/).

Fairline Targa 12m: Sporty and Stylish

The Fairline Targa 12m is a British-built sports cruiser with a reputation for performance. It seats up to 10 passengers and is perfect for those who want a faster, more dynamic experience on the water. The open-plan cockpit and sleek lines make it a head-turner in Puerto Banús. Pricing is on request — contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. This boat is also a great option for a [Marbella sunset cruise](/blog/marbella-sunset-boat-charter-guide/).

Which One Should You Choose?

Your choice depends on three factors: passenger count, budget, and preferred style. If you need the lowest price and have 9 people or fewer, the Astondoa 40 is a solid, comfortable pick. If you need space for 10–11 guests and want fixed pricing, go for the Azimut 39. If you value speed and a sportier aesthetic, the Fairline Targa 12m is your boat — just be prepared to request a price. All three include a licensed skipper, so you can sit back and enjoy the views of the Golden Mile, Cabopino, or even Estepona.

What’s Included on All Charters?

Every charter from Boat Rental Marbella comes with the same all-inclusive package: a professional skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, full insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden extras. You can also bring your own food and drinks if you wish. For longer trips, consider an 8-hour charter to explore as far as Sotogrande or Cala del Faro.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which boat is best for a large group?

The Azimut 39 accommodates up to 11 passengers, the highest capacity among the three. The Fairline Targa 12m takes 10, and the Astondoa 40 takes 9. For maximum space, the Azimut 39 is the best choice.

Are the prices the same for all three boats?

No. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are both Tier A boats, priced at €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours. The Fairline Targa 12m is priced on request — contact us via WhatsApp for a quote.

What is included in the charter?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

Which boat is the fastest?

The Fairline Targa 12m is a sport cruiser known for its performance and speed, making it ideal for thrill-seekers. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are more relaxed cruisers, focusing on comfort and stability.

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own provisions. However, our standard package already includes a selection of drinks and snacks. No corkage fee applies.

Do these boats have a bathroom?

Yes, all three boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39, and Fairline Targa 12m) are equipped with a cabin and a marine toilet, providing comfort for longer trips.

What is the cancellation policy?

Cancellations made 48 hours or more before departure are fully refundable. Within 48 hours, a 50% charge applies. No-shows are non-refundable. Weather cancellations are handled on a case-by-case basis.
